items.title: Albert Burbank Interview, 1962-01-04
items.q: There's a couple of drummers that you don't hear and they talk about them. But I think they're real good for Dixieland music. There's Barney Smilton and Albert Giles.

ctx.x: Do you do that much now? I don't do that much now. I don't take the chance to. No. Who are the drummers around sound that you think are good now? Any other good that are left? Oh, yeah. There's a lot of good ones. I think they're all good. If you had a band, who would you hire for the drums?

Oh, well, there's so many of them that I know. There's a couple of drummers that you don't hear and they talk about them. But I think they're real good for Dixieland music. There's Barney Smilton and Albert Giles. Well, I know you worked with Giles and Father Al at one time. Yeah. Up on a magazine or something, I think you don't forget it.
Yeah. If you had a rhythm section that you could pick, would you rather have a piano or a banjo?
